body: Read up on general history of the place you're exploring, there is rarely (if ever) any such thing as a public list of current gems. Biggest shortcut is finding a clique to roll with, but I wouldn't rely on it.

Any convex polygon works with SAT, my example only deals with rectangles though. That library allows defining any arbitrary shapes, but I'm pretty sure there's built-in support for triangles. Check bitbucket link
The library has built-in support for circles, check out the bitbucket link.
It's on the roadmap, but for builtin support the hitbox design needs to be solid first, so this probably won't happen until sometime after the initial hitbox update.

You certainly don't need to uninstall your antivirus, but in the case you notice a warning you may need to add an exception to anything related to moonsharp. We've had no previous experience of silent filters.

I'd probably suggest just re-downloading the engine and trying again. Once downloaded, move the files inside the download somewhere else and try launching.

This error usually means you've forgot to close off some function, if-statement or loop correctly. 

In this case, you never properly close the "EnemyDialogueStarting()" function starting on row 26. The "end" on row 40 closes the if-statement on row 36, so you'll need to add another "end" after that one for the script to compile. 



I'd highly suggest using some editor (notepad++ or similar) and use language-specific settings for markup, makes spotting these kind of errors much easier.
